scope: Composite Max selection with faithful resolved Max or Min state; consumed Min compositor is explicitly added so observed Max-entry outputs are representable. This does not accept standalone SelectMin/Invert/LUT-edit workflows or a whole family.
precedence: All exact base-proposal contracts apply except the explicitly superseded fields below. This adoption is the effective implementation contract; the base remains an immutable reviewed proposal.

superseded.cpp_api.ChannelDisplayProjection: enum class ChannelDisplayProjection { Sum, Max, Min };
superseded.request_dispatch.SelectMax.result: Native resolves qualified transition once; complete V2 state has projection Max or Min, Composite for C<=8 or Color fallback above8; optional deliberate C0 navigation is separate.
superseded.action_contract.v2.select_max_consistenc: V2 state; projection Max or Min only, never Sum; mode Composite C<=8 or Color C>8; reset arrays empty; display_dependency nonnull; navigation null or explicit C0 only. No transform or reclassification during decode/replay.
superseded.transition_decision_table: All R12-R18 hosted outcomes adopted at exact qualified input/table/position identities. No owned forced-Max correction or atomic refusal of observed Min outcomes.
superseded.ui_owned_contract.max_visibility: Retain flags when starting Composite; when entering Composite from Color/Gray set all actual channels visible. Existing Color/Gray/ordinary Composite action behavior remains.
superseded.remaining_freeze_boundary: Representation and transition policy settled by this adoption. Freeze exact implementation source and native/API/SDK/host/physical gate membership next; do not repeat qualified reference entry.

select_max_algorithm: Require a captured recognized V1/V2 channel state; no supplied state/reset channels; absent, future, malformed or unsupported state refuses.

Validate source/position and positive limits; checked preflight the C-dependent state/table/record working footprint before cloning/classification/transformation or callbacks. No source pixel/provider reads or Auto range scan.
Copy immutable consumed state before any callback. Classify a gray ascending processor table in Grayscale or singleton Composite; otherwise classify the active C stored named/custom table.
Source classifier is inverted exactly when no adjacent RGB-sum increase exists for indices1..254 inclusive; exclude the254-to255 step. Constant tables classify inverted.

Begin resolved projection Max. If active processor classifies inverted, transform every RGB entry using rgb[k]+255-min(rgb)-max(rgb), retain ranges, store explicit custom tables, and record deliberate navigation C0 even if original C0.
After transformation classify the resulting C0 table; if inverted the resolved projection is Min. Preserve captured T/Z and every unrelated display field.
If starting mode was not Composite set all actual channel flags true; otherwise retain all flags. Normalize requested Composite above8 to Color while retaining full state/version/projection.

Return immutable V2 complete state/action, historical captured display revision and optional C effect. Fresh publication checks Pixels/Metadata/Display; strict replay checks binding but applies stored resolved effects to fresh navigation without reclassification.

rendering.admission: Existing U8/U16/F32 scalar and quietNaN policy; all existing processor mapping/range defaults unchanged.
rendering.max: Component-wise maximum of mapped visible C bytes.
rendering.min: Component-wise minimum of mapped visible C bytes. Initialize from first actual contributor, then take minima; never seed Min accumulation with black.
rendering.owned_empty_policy: No visible contributors returns fresh black for all projections with no provider reads. All pixels including pixel0 are deterministic; do not reproduce upstream stale-cache/empty artifacts.
rendering.inactive_projection: Color/Grayscale ignore stored projection; singleton Composite retains existing gray rule. Preserve V2 projection/version during ordinary edits.
rendering.capture_before_callback: Capture selected effective projection, contributing channels, tables and ranges before provider/checkpoint callbacks. Do not reread mutable caller state in kernel.
rendering.retained_limits: Reuse16MiPixel/128MiB native compositor limits and configured clamp; no TCZ copies or total-process-memory claim.

metadata_preflight.new_intent: SelectMax is metadata-only. Positive max_pixels/max_working_bytes required; max_pixels is not an image-area admission limit for this intent because no pixels are allocated/read. Bound source-derived C state/table/normalized record copies with checked arithmetic against max_working_bytes before cloning/callbacks; report/refuse oversized state.
metadata_preflight.old_actions: Existing Set/Disable metadata-only callback behavior and Reset live-scan semantics unchanged.
metadata_preflight.cancellation_order: Validate request/source and checked working preflight first. Valid pre-canceled SelectMax throws OperationCancelled before user checkpoint callbacks. Own the captured state/table inputs before the first user callback; poll existing cancellation/checkpoint at bounded metadata work boundaries and before return. No publication/record append is performed by resolver. Existing Set/Disable callbacks remain untouched.
metadata_preflight.above8: SelectMax C>8 Color fallback and full-C flags/table transformation follow the explicitly owned normalization policy. R09 proves programmatic fallback only, not real Channels input; do not label this extension hosted transition parity.

compatibility: V1 exact bytes/fields/default SUM and old aggregate source spellings remain unchanged.
V2 SUM/Max/Min retention is explicit; future V3 headers remain opaque in generic native transport and refuse interpretation.
Appending state fields changes C++ layout: rebuild coherent core/headers/bindings/desktop/SDK; no mixed old/new ABI claim.
Strict full original validation before replay/rebind; replay never reruns LUT transforms/Reset; optional C0 effect preserves current T/Z.
Record navigation nonnull implies select_max and C0; resolved Max/Min state alone does not authenticate a historical transform.
Typed direct Set V2 Max/Min is distinct from source-derived SelectMax; no implied LUT/position changes.
Ordinary Composite UI explicitly selects SUM, retaining V2 identity; Max always queues one native intent even when already Max.
Panel displays Composite Min when the resolved state is Min; it does not silently label it Max or expose an unqualified standalone Min-entry intent.

native_gate.acceptance: Exact independent membership frozen before first affected build. Developer native checks are intermediate; installed API/core-only SDK/public desktop bindings/host/paired physical/persistence/regression/artifact gates remain mandatory.

classifier_context_policy.authority: Native intent classifies native state, not historical Java processor cache state. Grayscale and singleton Composite use gray; otherwise active stored LUT. This is a declared owned deterministic policy outside the qualified hosted rows.
classifier_context_policy.qualified_matches: R12-R18 first selections and R18 repeat use their exact observed state/table/position results.
classifier_context_policy.not_claimed: After R14 Gray-to-Composite, upstream can retain a gray processor base LUT while stored selected LUT is inverted; a later unobserved repeated click may differ from the native state-derived policy. No cache state is invented/persisted; retain this compatibility limitation for full G033 workflow review.
